title: BrokenPick
description: this mod basically makes mining bit more stratigic task instead of punching holes in wall, and gives more of a nieche to explosives
body:
heres a video showcasing this mod(it is my channel so pls subscribe :) ): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WcWQysO19Ro

other than it, this mod is all about making mining specifically tunneling harder, and giving use to tnt such explosives

so here how it works,

every block based on its hardness will have corresponding amount of adjecant blocks it before becoming real slow to mine (sometimes as uch as 6x slower, but for balancing reason obsidian 'n such will be only 2x slower)

and since this mod takes in block hardness as value, modded blocks will be affected too (no config files needed)

altho I will be planning to add seperate config file to provide bit more flexibility but hey, this is a mod that does one thing and does it really well
